theorems.name: Submission.dohr_lmo_density_usc
theorems.statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (y : Amb n ℓ) (t₁ : ℝ) (Λ : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < t₁ → Tendsto Λ (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → (∀ t ∈ Ioc 0 t₁, ∀ z ∈ closedBall y t, ∃ Θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ Θ ∧ V.HasDensity z Θ ∧ ∀ r ∈ Ioo 0 t, unitBallVolume n * Θ ≤ Real.exp (Λ t) * (r ^ n)⁻¹ * (V.weight (closedBall z r)).toReal + Λ t) → ∀ Θy : ℝ, 0 ≤ Θy → V.HasDensity y Θy → ∀ c : ℝ, Θy < c → ∃ d > 0, ∀ z ∈ closedBall y d, ∃ Θ : ℝ, Θ < c ∧ V.HasDensity z Θ
